title: decree retry --format json
description: What `decree retry --format json` prints on stdout: the run made `pending` again and the state it continues in, which a running `decree daemon`, or the next `decree daemon --once`, continues. On failure nothing is printed on stdout; the error goes to stderr and the exit code is 1. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Machine-readable output.

state.description: The atomic state the run continues in.
